subject: Scheduling: Dedicated capacity sizing call / throughput & latency requirements
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:23:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up + next step: dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo today — really appreciated the context on Nimbus Health's real-time summarization use case. As discussed, the next best step is a dedicated capacity sizing call so our infra/solutions engineers can walk through throughput/latency sizing and deployment options.

To make the call productive, we typically cover:
- Expected sustained QPS and peak bursts (RPS or requests/min)
- Concurrent sessions / users and session length (avg tokens per request)
- Latency SLOs (p50/p95/p99 target) and acceptable tail behavior
- Model choices (decoder-only, chat model, seq length) and any quantization requirements
- Data locality / private deployment needs and security constraints

I've attached a short capacity template (nimbus_capacity_template.xlsx) — if you can fill the highlighted fields before the call it helps us prepare.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue Dec 2, 10:00–10:45 AM
- Wed Dec 3, 2:00–2:45 PM

Please pick whichever works or share a few windows and I’ll send a calendar invite. Logan (cc'd) is our solutions engineer and will lead the technical discussion.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Great recap, thanks. Wed Dec 3 at 2:00 PM PST works for our team. Can you invite Logan and any other infra folks who will join?

A couple quick notes so Logan can prep: we care about end-to-end p95 latency from client to response (not just inference server), and we expect to be bursty around product launches (peak ~1.2k requests/min for short periods). Avg request size is ~300 tokens, max around 1k tokens for longer sessions.

Priya will be the procurement lead on our side and will follow up on any contract questions after sizing.

Thanks — looking forward to the call. A couple things I’ll bring to the conversation and would appreciate Alex/Priya confirming before we meet:
- Expected sustained QPS and typical burst duration (you mentioned ~1.2k/min peak — is burst ~1–5 minutes or longer?)
- Token profile: avg 300, 1k max, and % of requests that hit the max (helps with memory/KV sizing)
- Target p95 and p99 latencies (end-to-end) and any hard SLA requirements
- Any constraints on model variants (e.g., need to run a particular open model or can we recommend quantized variants)

I attached a one-page pre-call checklist (precall_checklist.pdf) that lists the above and a couple extra items (network egress constraints, VPC requirements). If you can drop answers in the doc or reply inline, we’ll be able to bring concrete capacity numbers.

See you on Wed.

—Logan
